name: Craftsman's Writ: Pearl-Handled Dagger
summary: A transferable writ requests a Pearl-Handled Dagger and gives terms for its delivery and payment. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The note is written in faded ink, and it names a Pearl-Handled Dagger among the items wanted. Its lower lines give a delivery place and payment terms. The writ can pass from hand to hand, but you need to hold it when you complete the exchange.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests a Pearl-Handled Dagger.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the item?
faq.answer: The delivery location is marked on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.
Yes. The writ says it can be transferred.

faq.q: Do I need to keep the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. You need the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Pearl-Handled Dagger
